overview: Euclid DR1 strong-lens papers dominate, with CNN ablations and vision-transformer segmentation. Other work applies neural posterior estimation to FRB cosmology and JWST exoplanet retrieval, Gaussian-process emulators to Galileon power spectra, and unsupervised clustering to IllustrisTNG and FRB bursts; a 963-planet mass-radius benchmark is presented.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens detection and segmentation
Neural posterior estimation and simulation-based inference
Emulators for cosmology and nuclear equations of state
Unsupervised learning of galaxies and FRBs
